definitions: To worsen an already difficult or bad situation by doing something else that makes it even more unpleasant or upsetting.
To make a bad situation worse by doing something else that offends or humiliates.
examples: First, my car broke down, and then, to add insult to injury, I got a parking ticket.
They lost the match, and to add insult to injury, their star player was injured in the final minute.
Not only did they reject my proposal, but to add insult to injury, they didn't even give me a reason.
synonyms: to rub salt in the wound
